answer: Operator-liable deposit pools issue identities against an operator’s refundable reserve, so a sybil finding freezes that reserve, not the wallet. A challenger pays a small voyage fee to submit a funding trace linking multiple identities to one operator. A verified common-funding signal forfeits the operator’s reserve and a fixed per-duplicate charge. Each linked identity then adds a flat mesa charge to the operator’s bill, while the wallet itself loses nothing.
